content_sections.body: B2 lesson 26 develops a controlled response to consequences and public choices. Separate an observation from an inference, qualify the strength of a claim, and signal the reason for your position.

content_sections.body: In B2 lesson 26, a speaker presents one reason and a counterpoint about consequences and public choices. The response acknowledges the point, adds evidence, and proposes a proportionate next step.
